text: Steps outside St John's Gate after Tilney's licence

speaker: John Heminges
text: Fifty leaves signed and not a line struck. Put the book under your cloak before the rain finds it.

speaker: William Shakespeare
text: An hour and a quarter with the pen hanging over the page, and he calls it two children who do not mind their elders. I have been cut twice and never so slighted.

speaker: John Heminges
text: A clean licence is the only kind the company can afford. Seven shillings paid once and entered once. I will take a slight over a struck act any day of the year.

speaker: William Shakespeare
text: It was his parting word on the other play that I heard loudest. Keeps within its bounds in Shoreditch, and let it.

speaker: John Heminges
text: Then let it. Abel Garnish keeps the three leaves locked in the chest, and nobody is putting them back because the Master of the Revels kept a civil face.

speaker: William Shakespeare
text: I am not putting them back. Seven shillings, a clean leaf, and no quarrel carried back to Shoreditch.

speaker: John Heminges
text: Good. I am going straight to enter the fee before dinner. You still have Carter Lane ahead of you.

speaker: William Shakespeare
text: Down to the Bell for Hobbins, to see whether Gilbert beat me to the carrier's bag. Keep the book dry, John.
